answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement is 0.955 and sequence agreement is 0.688, both inside the quantized ranges (0.945-0.955 and 0.67-0.70). They are above the fine-tuned (0.900-0.938, 0.47-0.64) and system-prompted (0.861-0.908, 0.31-0.48) ranges. KL of 0.030 and TV of 0.038 are slightly below the quantized ranges (0.039-0.071 and 0.048-0.055). They are still the closest to quantized and far below the other categories. This is a single draw, so some variation is expected. Base is ruled out because the values are non-zero. Fine-tuned is the next most plausible, but its top-1 and sequence agreement are too high for it. Token-DiFR gap of 0.052 is a little above the quantized range of 0.03-0.04, and raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.2 is above the quantized 2.2-2.3, so those fit less well, but the overall pattern is the mildest perturbation.
